title: Label smoothing under label noise
setting: A two-layer MLP trained with Adam for 150 full-batch steps on the 8x8 digits dataset. A fraction of training labels can be replaced with random classes. Test accuracy is measured on 500 clean held-out images.

paper.title: Does label smoothing mitigate label noise?
paper.claim: Label smoothing is competitive with loss-correction methods under label noise.

factors.name: method
factors.description: training loss: plain cross entropy or cross entropy with label smoothing 0.2

factors.name: label_noise
factors.description: fraction of training labels replaced with a random class
